rag.text:
Test: TC-1179 — Box module - Board - Totals - Counting work progress by tasks
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-102 Box module - Board - Totals
Labels: Sanity, can_be_automated, rocksolid, teamsmile

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Board module of the boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1179 Box module - Board - Totals - Counting work progress by tasks
   Expected: Module opened correctly.
2. Click View -> Totals -> Work progress -> Tasks
   Expected: Bars progress are visible in every PI and swimlane. PI1 has 7/12 58% tasks done and PI2 has 2/3 67% tasks done.
3. Click on Filters -> Filters option and check Show only tasks not planned on a lower level
   Expected: Bars progress are visible in every PI and swimlane. PI1 has 2/4 50% tasks done and PI2 has 2/3 67% tasks done.
4. Click on Filters -> Filters option and uncheck Show only tasks not planned on a lower level
   Expected: Bars progress are visible in every PI and swimlane. PI1 has 7/12 58% tasks done and PI2 has 2/3 67% tasks done.
5. Select issueName in PI1 in Team 1 and change status on status1
   Data: issueName: T14
status1: In progress
   Expected: Issue has been updated. PI1 has still 7/12 58% tasks done and Team 1 has still 6/9 67%
6. Select issueName in PI1 in Team 1  and change status on status2
   Data: issueName: T14
status2: Done
   Expected: Issue has been updated. PI1 has 8/12 67% tasks done and Team 1 has  7/9 78%
7. Move issueName from PI1 Team 1 to PI2 Team unassigned
   Data: issueName: T4
   Expected: Issue has been moved. PI1 has 7/11 64% tasks done, Team 1 of PI1 has 6/8 75%, PI2 has 3/4 75% and Team unassigned of PI2 has 2/2 100%
8. Level down to Iterations of PI1
   Expected: Progress bar of PI1 is not visible. User sees two Iterations. Every Iteration and swimlane has progress bars. Iteration1 has 1/3 33% tasks done, Iteration2 3/4 75%.
9. Select issueName in Iteration1 in Team unassigned and change status on status2
   Data: issueName: T10
status2: Done
   Expected: Issue has been updated. Iteration1 has 2/3 67% tasks done and Team unassigned has 1/1 100%.
10. Move issueName from Iteration1 Team unassigned to Iteration2 Team unassigned
   Data: issueName: T10
   Expected: Issue has been moved. Iteration1 has 1/2 50% tasks done, progress bars of Team unassigned of Iteration1 is not visible, Iteration2 has 4/5 80% and Team unassigned of Iteration2 has 2/2 100%.
11. Move issueName from Iteration2 Team unassigned to Iteration1 Team 1
   Data: issueName: T12
   Expected: Issue has been moved. Iteration2 has 3/4 75% tasks done, Team 1 in Iteration1 has 2/3 67%, Team unassigned of Iteration2 has 1/1 100%.
12. Click 'Zoom out' button on the timeline.
   Expected: Progress bars of PI1 are not visible. User see three Iterations. Iteration3 has 1/1 100% tasks done.
